title: feat(spec,lint,cli): a page:tabs item label gains the key pages.PAGE.components.TABS.items.VALUE.label
body:
Closes #24968

Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What changes

A `page:tabs` item's `label` had no translation key. `TranslationBundle` `pages.PAGE.components` is keyed by component id. A tab item is not a component and carries no id. Spec `translatePage` descended `items[].children` but never read `items[].label`. HotCRM measured this on `sales_home_page`: three English tabs under a translated header, in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES.

- **Spec** (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`): `pages.PAGE.components.TABS_ID.items.VALUE.label` is a declared key. The component entry gains `items`, a record keyed by the tab item's `value`. Each entry is closed (`strictObject`, surface "this page tab item translation"). `title`, `name` and `text` are renames onto `label`. (The `tabs` alias onto `items` was dropped in `f18a2f55dd`.)
- **Resolver** (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`): `translatePage` overlays each item's `label` from the key. It resolves across the locale chain item by item, under the same `addressed` collision arbitration as the component copy. Only `page:tabs` components are read. Two new exports are shared by the resolver, the extractor and the lint check, so the three cannot drift: `PAGE_TABS_COMPONENT_TYPE` and `pageTabItemKey(item)`.
- **Walk** (`walkAddressedPageComponents`): the walk used to rebuild a panel list from the authored node, so a visitor's edit to a panel's own key (its `label`) was overwritten. A panel's own keys now come from the visitor's return when the visitor keeps the list's authored shape (same length, an object at every panel position). Panel `children` are still descended from the authored document, so the walk still owns the descent. A visitor that changes the shape gets the authored list back. The docblocks state this, and a new walk test pins it.
- **`objectstack validate`** (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`): the check builds a per-page universe with spec's `walkAddressedPageComponents`, the same walk `translatePage` runs. A `components.ID.items.VALUE` key resolves over a declared `page:tabs` item `value`. Otherwise it is refused as `translation-target-unknown`, in the existing one-line verdict style:
  - an unknown value (an index token such as `tab-2` included): "...which `page:tabs` "home_tabs" on page "sales_home_page" gives no item as its `value`, so the tab keeps its source-locale label.", followed by "Did you mean";
  - a `page:accordion`: "...whose panels have no stable key, so nothing resolves them.", with a fix line pointing at the inline locale map;
  - another component type: "...declares as a `record:related_list`, not a `page:tabs`...";
  - an undeclared component id: "...a component id page "P" does not declare...", followed by "Did you mean" over the page's tabs components.
- **`os i18n extract` / coverage** (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`): `emitPageComponentCopy` writes a slot for every valued item of an addressed `page:tabs`. A reader exists (`translatePage`), so the slot is demanded, which differs from #24943. An inline locale map on the label is recorded as authored, through the same `pushEntry` path as the component keys.

## Why this spelling (shape (a) over (b))

- **Keyed by `value`, under the tabs component's id.** `PageTabsProps.items[]` already declares the identifier the key needs. `value` is the stable `?tab=` token that the renderer reads and restores, so it is unique within the strip. The #14749 ruling (Q3 = C3, quoted in the extractor's header) recorded the direction "identity first: `component.id` / `section.name` / `tabs item.value`". Adding an `id` to tab items (shape (b)) would give one tab two identifiers. It would also make `components.ID` address something that is not a component, and it would need a new authorable key on a published schema. Shape (a) adds no authorable page key and reuses the grammar the face already has, the same way `dashboards.D.widgets.ID` and `flows.F.screens.NODE` key a child by the identifier its consumer already holds.
- **An item without a `value` has no key.** Its renderer token is `tab-INDEX`. The #14749 ruling forbids array-index keys, because reordering two tabs would swap their translations with every check still green. The lint verdict names the remedy: give the item a `value`.
- **Inline locale maps keep working.** `translatePage` writes only where the bundle has an entry. An item the bundle does not key keeps its map, and a bundle entry wins where both exist. This is the rule the component copy already follows.
- **Accordion is out on purpose.** `page:accordion` items have no author-settable identity (the renderer derives `panel-INDEX`, and `value` is refused on them with guidance), so their labels stay an inline-map surface.

## Tests

- **Repro first**: commit `757aadb573` adds the tests before the fix. At that commit, on a rebuilt spec dist, the spec suite had 9 failing cases (4 schema, 4 resolver, 1 walk), the lint suite had 7 (5 refusal cases plus the two one-line arm coverage checks), and the new CLI file did not load, because the closure was not built yet.
- **Flipped pin**: the `BOUNDARY` case in `i18n-resolver.test.ts` ("a tab panel label has no bundle key") said "If a key is added, this pin is the one to flip". It is flipped: its inline-map half is kept as a CONTROL, and the new `translatePage — page:tabs item labels` block pins the key.
- **Controls**: panel children keep their own `components.ID` keys; the tabs component's own `label` key composes with its item keys; the same `items` key on a `page:accordion` translates nothing; an item without a `value` is untouched even if `tab-2` is keyed; the locale-chain fallback works key by key; the component keys of the page validate clean beside an item key; a page the stack does not declare is not judged.
- **Package runs** (merged head `c8a248af73`, local base `origin/main` `7adfaec2a1`):
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 703 files, 21377 passed, 1 todo.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 152 files, 7033 passed.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`: 316 files, 4629 passed, 29 skipped. Two published-subpath pins first refused because `packages/cli` itself was not built. That is a prerequisite refusal, not a measurement. After building the CLI they passed, with the new file: 3 files, 37 passed. The `integration` tier is declared to CI, since the diff touches no spawn entry.
  - `typecheck` for spec, lint and cli: exit 0 (each runs `tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck`).
- **Generated artifacts**: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix` regenerated `api-surface/system.json` and `export-origins/system.json` (the two new exports) and the strictness-ledger counts (`system.md`). The reference doc `translation.mdx` is unchanged, because its `components` cell is truncated with an ellipsis before `items`.
- **Reverse verification** (after the fix was committed). Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor hit once, and the restore was proven by `blob == HEAD` with an empty `git diff HEAD`. Each suite reads `src`.
  - A1, the `translatePageTabItems` call removed: spec resolver suite `4 failed | 363 passed`.
  - A2, the walk forced back to the authored panel keys: `5 failed | 362 passed` (the 4 above plus the walk pin).
  - A3, lint accepting every value: `4 failed | 190 passed` (the two value refusals and the two one-line arm-coverage checks).
  - A4, the extractor's item slot removed: the CLI file `4 failed | 4 passed`.
- **Derived gates** (`dispatch-gates --commands`, reconciled with `--ran` with exit codes recorded): 94 derived, 93 run, all exit 0. `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage` and `check:i18n-walk-parity` first refused with exit 3 (the CLI was not built). After the build they were re-run and exited 0: `check:i18n` reports 10 packages in sync, `check:i18n-coverage` reports 14 configs with none new, and `check:i18n-walk-parity` reports 11 declared groups, 9 walked and 2 exempted. NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3), because packages this diff does not touch have no `dist` without a whole-repo `pnpm build`. Declared to CI. `check:nul-bytes`: exit 0.
- **eslint, narrowed to the 8 touched source and test files** (`--no-inline-config --format json`, at `c8a248af73`): 8 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The config declares no type-aware linting (`eslint.config.mjs`: no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.

## Review tier

`packages/spec` is a published schema, so this PR owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record before it enters the queue (pm-dispatch `references/contract-review.md`). It touches no governed surface (`.claude/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `AGENTS.md`, workflows, `skills/**`), so no Tier S or Tier H landing rule applies.

## Liveness

`packages/spec/liveness/translation.json`'s `pages` row is `live` and not drilled, so its blanket verdict covers the new member. The reader is `translatePage`, which the REST metadata read applies through `translateMetadataDocument`. objectui's `page:tabs` renders a string label as is.

## Acceptance notes

- `objectstack validate` still judges no other `pages.PAGE` member. An unknown page name, an unknown component id carrying only copy keys, and an unknown copy target are not checked by this rule today. This PR judges only the `items` member it adds, and skips pages the stack does not declare.
- `page:accordion` panel labels have no bundle key (no stable identity). This is deliberate and recorded in the schema docblock.
- `#24947` (this seat's open PR) also touches `i18n-extract.ts`, in a different function (bulk-confirm template slots). No textual overlap is expected.
- The branch carries a `wip:` commit (`818b89e351`) between the repro and the fix commit. This PR is squash-landed, so it does not reach `main`. I did not rewrite the history.
